messages.subject: Re: tumor purity estimation by Canopy
messages.body_plain:
Hi Jinxiong,

Thanks for your interest in Canopy. The tumor purity is 1-the percentage of normal cells, and the normal cells by default is the first clone in the reconstructed tree.

I hope that this is helpful.
Yuchao
